headline: Public hearing held on $55,000 donation from Canine Companions for a support dog.
summary: Mayor Ruais explained that each speaker would have up to three minutes to comment. The meeting then adjourned.
plain_text:
SPECIAL PUBLIC HEARING MEETING OF THE 
BOARD OF SCHOOL COMMITTEE  
MANCHESTER SCHOOL DISTRICT SAU #37 
 
Monday, October 26, 2026 6:30 p.m. 
 
 
1. Mayor Ruais called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m. 
 
2. The Clerk called the roll.  
 
Present:  Committee Members Turner, Parr, Georges, Taylor, Stewart, 
O’Connell, Spencer, Garrity, Hamer, Smith, Mayor Ruais and Student 
Member Langlois. 
 
Absent: Committee Members Want, St. John and O’Neil were absent.  Ward 6 
seat still vacant at this time. 
 
 
3. Mayor Ruais advises the purpose of the special public hearing meeting is to give the 
residents of Manchester the opportunity to address the board regarding a donation of 
$55,000 from Canine Companions for a support/companion dog.  All people wishing to 
speak will have up to three (3) minutes to do so, and any comments must be directed to 
the chair.  Any resident wishing to speak will come forward to the nearest microphone, 
clearly state their name and address when recognized and give their comments. 
 
 
There was no one present wishing to give comment during the public hearing. 
 
 
5. This being a special meeting of the board, no further business can be presented unless by 
2/3 majority and a motion is in order to adjourn. 
 
 
This being a special meeting, no further business was presented.  On motion of Committee 
Member Turner, duly seconded by Committee Member Parr, it was moved to adjourn.  All 
were in favor, meeting adjourned at 6:31 p.m. 
 
True Copy.  Attest. 
Respectfully Submitted, 
  
 
Clerk of Committee
